echo "== STEP 1: baseline MAC state =="
sudo -n getenforce 2>/dev/null || true
sudo -n aa-status --enforced 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true
sudo -n systemctl is-active apparmor

echo "== STEP 2: create inventory app =="
sudo -n mkdir -p /opt/inventory-app
sudo -n tee /opt/inventory-app/inventory.json >/dev/null <<'JSON'
{
  "items": [
    {"sku": "SKU-1001", "name": "Widget", "qty": 42},
    {"sku": "SKU-1002", "name": "Gadget", "qty": 17},
    {"sku": "SKU-1003", "name": "Doohickey", "qty": 5}
  ]
}
JSON

sudo -n tee /opt/inventory-app/app.py >/dev/null <<'PY'
import json
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer

INVENTORY_PATH = "/opt/inventory-app/inventory.json"

class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        with open(INVENTORY_PATH, "rb") as f:
            body = f.read()
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        pass

if __name__ == "__main__":
    server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", 8181), Handler)
    server.serve_forever()
PY

sudo -n chown -R root:root /opt/inventory-app
sudo -n chmod 755 /opt/inventory-app
sudo -n chmod 644 /opt/inventory-app/inventory.json /opt/inventory-app/app.py

echo "== STEP 3: systemd unit =="
sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/inventory-app.service >/dev/null <<'UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Inventory application on port 8181
After=network.target apparmor.service

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /opt/inventory-app/app.py
Restart=on-failure
User=root
AppArmorProfile=inventory-app

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
UNIT

echo "== STEP 4: AppArmor profile (enforce mode) =="
sudo -n tee /etc/apparmor.d/inventory-app >/dev/null <<'PROFILE'
#include <tunables/global>

profile inventory-app /usr/bin/python3.12 flags=(enforce) {
  #include <abstractions/base>
  #include <abstractions/python>

  network inet stream,
  network inet6 stream,

  /usr/bin/python3.12 mr,
  /opt/inventory-app/ r,
  /opt/inventory-app/app.py r,
  /opt/inventory-app/inventory.json r,
  /usr/lib/python3.12/**  r,
  /usr/lib/python3.12/**.so* mr,
  /etc/ld.so.cache r,
  /proc/sys/kernel/random/uuid r,

  deny /home/** rwklx,
  deny /root/** rwklx,
  deny /etc/shadow rwklx,
}
PROFILE

sudo -n apparmor_parser -r /etc/apparmor.d/inventory-app
echo "profile load exit: $?"

echo "== STEP 5: enable + start service =="
sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl enable inventory-app.service
sudo -n systemctl restart inventory-app.service
sleep 2
sudo -n systemctl is-active inventory-app.service

echo "== STEP 6: verify =="
